meta.name: og-dbr-rev0-200mw
meta.notes: The Rev 0 system, unchanged, against a 200 MW Class A design fire instead of the Annex 7 minimum of 150 MW. ONLY the fire block differs from og-dbr-rev0: same nozzle, same K and pressure, same 3 x 30 m zoning, same 75 heads and 2175 lpm, same ventilation and detection. The question this design asks is whether the sized system still holds a larger fire, so nothing about the system may move without making it a different question. See solit2/presets/fire_hgv_200mw.json for what the 200 MW load is and what about it is this project's extrapolation rather than the standard's.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria.

ahj.note: Only one acceptance limit is set, because only one is stated by an authority. HPWM-TECHNICAL SPEC_R2 section 6 requires a 150 MW minimum design fire load reduced to <= 50 MW. Every other Annex 7 criterion stays null and is reported 'unset': the tender defers tenability to 'SOLIT2 or NFPA 502 test protocols' without naming numbers, and Annex 7 7.1 leaves those to the authority having jurisdiction. Do not fill them from a vendor's test report -- see INDEPENDENCE.md rule 2.
